description: React component for adding and managing tags on selected items, including UI elements like menu, popover, and icon interactions.

classes.name: AddTagOption
classes.description: React functional component for adding tags to items, with UI for tag selection and linking/unlinking.

methods.name: toggleMenu
methods.description: Toggles the open state of the tag menu popover.

methods.name: isTagLinkedToSelectedItems
methods.description: Checks if a given tag is linked to all selected items.

methods.name: linkTagToSelectedItems
methods.description: Links a given tag to all selected items.

methods.name: unlinkTagFromSelectedItems
methods.description: Unlinks a given tag from all selected items.
